protocol.name: treeland_show_desktop_unstable_v1

protocol.description:
Warning! This protocol is EXPERIMENTAL and under active development. It may change at any time, including in backward-incompatible ways, without incrementing the interface major version and without prior notice. No compatibility guarantees of any kind are provided. Clients and compositors must track the upstream definition in treeland-protocols and must not rely on the current interface names, requests, events, or semantics remaining stable across releases.
This protocol allows a privileged client such as a dock or desktop shell to control and observe the compositor's show-desktop mode. In show-desktop mode the compositor minimizes or hides all toplevel windows to reveal the desktop surface underneath.
The terms "must", "must not", "should", and "may" in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.

interface.name: treeland_show_desktop_v1
interface.description:
A singleton global that provides read/write access to the compositor's show-desktop mode state.
Only one client may bind this interface at a time. The compositor should reject subsequent bind attempts from other clients while a binding is already active.
On binding, the compositor immediately sends a show_desktop_state event carrying the current mode so that the client starts synchronized.
The client sends set_show_desktop_state to request a mode transition. The compositor applies the transition at its discretion and confirms the new state via a show_desktop_state event. The compositor may also emit show_desktop_state spontaneously when the mode changes through other means (e.g. a keyboard shortcut or gesture).

enum.name: state
enum.description: Describes the current display state of the desktop.

entry.name: show
entry.summary: all windows are hidden to reveal the desktop

request.name: destroy
request.description:
Destroy the treeland_show_desktop_v1 object and release the singleton binding. The compositor will accept a new binding from another client after this request is processed.
This request does not alter the current show-desktop mode; the compositor retains whatever state was last set.

request.name: set_show_desktop_state
request.description:
Request that the compositor transition to the given show-desktop mode. The compositor may ignore the request or apply it asynchronously. If the mode changes, the compositor confirms the new state by emitting a show_desktop_state event.
Sending the same mode that is already active is a no-op; the compositor need not emit a show_desktop_state event in response.

event.name: show_desktop_state
event.description:
Emitted by the compositor whenever the show-desktop mode changes, including once immediately after the client binds this interface to convey the initial state.
The compositor emits this event both in response to a set_show_desktop_state request and when the mode changes through any other compositor-side mechanism.
